email_body:
Dear Leadspring team,

I'm writing to apply for the General Virtual Assistant (SEO & Operations) role. Your focus on lead generation, affiliate marketing, and e-commerce resonates with my background in SEO, WordPress, and Shopify.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content creation, and SEO audits. I've built and optimized WordPress sites (including my own baverok.com and mirook.com) and managed Shopify stores (harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com), handling product catalogues and blog content. I also support project coordination by maintaining documentation and task tracking, ensuring projects stay organized.

I'm detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable juggling multiple tasks. I'd welcome the chance to bring my organizational skills and AI-driven efficiency to your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Leadspring team,

I'm excited to apply for the General Virtual Assistant (SEO & Operations) position. With a background in digital marketing and a technical edge, I thrive in dynamic environments where organization, AI, and SEO intersect—exactly the mix your role demands.

In my current freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT daily to streamline research, content creation, and SEO audits. I've built and optimized WordPress sites, including my own baverok.com and mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO. I also manage Shopify stores (harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com), handling product catalogues and blog content. These projects have honed my ability to juggle multiple tasks, maintain documentation, and coordinate with team members to keep projects on track.

My SEO knowledge spans on-page optimization, keyword research, and technical audits, backed by Semrush and Google Analytics certifications. I'm comfortable learning new software and tools quickly, and I bring a proactive, problem-solving mindset to every task. I understand the importance of reliable support for project managers and owners, and I'm eager to contribute to Leadspring's growth.

I'm fluent in English, detail-oriented, and adept at managing priorities in fast-paced settings. I'd love the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
